class TChatInput(ChatComponent):
    display_name = "TChat Input"
    description = "Кастомный вход вo флоу для телеметрии."
    icon = "MessagesSquare"
    name = "ChatInput"
    minimized = True

    inputs = [
        MultilineInput(
            name="input_value",
            display_name="Input Text",
            value="",
            info="Message to be passed as input.",
            input_types=[],
        ),
        BoolInput(
            name="should_store_message",
            display_name="Store Messages",
            info="Сохранить сообщение в истории.",
            value=True,
            advanced=True,
        ),
        DropdownInput(
            name="sender",
            display_name="Sender Type",
            options=[MESSAGE_SENDER_AI, MESSAGE_SENDER_USER],
            value=MESSAGE_SENDER_USER,
            info="Тип отправителя.",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="sender_name",
            display_name="Sender Name",
            info="Имя отправителя.",
            value=MESSAGE_SENDER_NAME_USER,
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="session_id",
            display_name="Session ID",
            info="ID сессии чата. Если не указан, будет использован текущий ID сессии параметра.",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        FileInput(
            name="files",
            display_name="Files",
            file_types=TEXT_FILE_TYPES + IMG_FILE_TYPES,
            info="Файлы, которые будут отправлены с сообщением.",
            advanced=True,
            is_list=True,
            temp_file=True,
        ),
    ]
    outputs = [Output(display_name="Chat Message", name="message", method="message_response")]

    async def message_response(self) -> Message:
        files = self.files if self.files else []
        if files and not isinstance(files, list):
            files = [files]
        files = [f for f in files if f is not None and f != ""]

        customer_id = self.graph.context.get("customer_id") or None
        source_channel_id = self.graph.context.get("source_channel_id") or None
        comod_session_id = self.graph.context.get("external_session_id") or None
        q_message_id = self.graph.context.get("q_message_id") or None
        logger.debug(
            "[DEBUG LOG] | customer_id=%s | x-cus=none | stage=tchat_input_graph_context | source_channel_id=%s | session_id=%s",
            customer_id,
            source_channel_id,
            self.session_id,
        )

        message = await Message.create(
            text=self.input_value,
            sender=self.sender,
            sender_name=self.sender_name,
            session_id=self.session_id,
            files=files,
            q_message_id=q_message_id
        )
        if customer_id:
            message.customer_id = customer_id
        if source_channel_id:
            message.source_channel_id = source_channel_id
        logger.debug(
            "[DEBUG LOG] | customer_id=%s | x-cus=none | stage=tchat_input_message_created | message_session_id=%s",
            getattr(message, "customer_id", None),
            getattr(message, "session_id", None),
        )
            
        if self.session_id and isinstance(message, Message) and self.should_store_message:
            stored_message = await self.send_message(
                message,
            )
            self.message.value = stored_message
            message = stored_message

        with trace_component(
            "Flow Execution",
            input_data={
                "user_message": getattr(message, "text", None),
                "source_channel_id": source_channel_id,
                "customer_id": customer_id,
                "comod_session_id": comod_session_id,
                "session_id": self.session_id if self.session_id else None,
            },
            obj=self,
            create_if_missing=True,
        ):
            pass

        self.status = message
        return message

from collections.abc import Generator
import logging
from typing import Any

import orjson
from fastapi.encoders import jsonable_encoder

from langflow.base.io.chat import ChatComponent
from langflow.helpers.data import safe_convert
from langflow.inputs.inputs import (
    BoolInput,
    DropdownInput,
    HandleInput,
    MessageTextInput,
)
from langflow.schema.data import Data

    MESSAGE_SENDER_AI,
    MESSAGE_SENDER_NAME_AI,
    MESSAGE_SENDER_USER,
)

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

class TChatOutput(ChatComponent):
    display_name = "TChat Output"
    description = "Кастомный выход из флоу для телеметрии."
    icon = "MessagesSquare"
    name = "ChatOutput"
    minimized = True

    inputs = [
        HandleInput(
            name="input_value",
            display_name="Inputs",
            info="Message to be passed as output.",
            input_types=["Data", "DataFrame", "Message"],
            required=True,
        ),
        BoolInput(
            name="should_store_message",
            display_name="Store Messages",
            info="Store the message in the history.",
            value=True,
            advanced=True,
        ),
        DropdownInput(
            name="sender",
            display_name="Sender Type",
            options=[MESSAGE_SENDER_AI, MESSAGE_SENDER_USER],
            value=MESSAGE_SENDER_AI,
            advanced=True,
            info="Type of sender.",
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="sender_name",
            display_name="Sender Name",
            info="Name of the sender.",
            value=MESSAGE_SENDER_NAME_AI,
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="session_id",
            display_name="Session ID",
            info="The session ID of the chat. If empty, the current session ID parameter will be used.",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="data_template",
            display_name="Data Template",
            value="{text}",
            advanced=True,
            info="Template to convert Data to Text. If left empty, it will be dynamically set to the Data's text key.",
        ),
    ]
    outputs = [
        Output(
            display_name="Output Message",
            name="message",
            method="message_response",
        ),
    ]

    def _build_source(self, id_: str | None, display_name: str | None, source: str | None) -> Source:
        source_dict = {}
        if id_:
            source_dict["id"] = id_
        if display_name:
            source_dict["display_name"] = display_name
        if source:
            # Handle case where source is a ChatOpenAI object
            if hasattr(source, "model_name"):
                source_dict["source"] = source.model_name
            elif hasattr(source, "model"):
                source_dict["source"] = str(source.model)
            else:
                source_dict["source"] = str(source)
        return Source(**source_dict)

    async def message_response(self) -> Message:
        source_channel_id = (
            self.graph.context.get("source_channel_id")
            if hasattr(self, "graph")
            else None
        )
        customer_id = (
            self.graph.context.get("customer_id") if hasattr(self, "graph") else None
        )
        logger.debug(
            "[DEBUG LOG] | customer_id=%s | x-cus=none | stage=tchat_output_graph_context | source_channel_id=%s | session_id=%s",
            customer_id,
            source_channel_id,
            self.session_id,
        )
        trace = None
        graph = getattr(self, "graph", None)
        context = getattr(graph, "context", {}) if graph else {}
        try:
            trace = None
            if isinstance(context, dict):
                trace = context.get("langfuse_flow_trace") or context.get("langfuse_trace")
        except Exception:
            trace = None

        # First convert the input to string if needed
        text = self.convert_to_string()

        # Get source properties
        source, _icon, display_name, source_id = self.get_properties_from_source_component()

        # Create or use existing Message object
        if isinstance(self.input_value, Message):
            message = self.input_value
            # Update message properties
            message.text = text
        else:
            message = Message(text=text)

        # Set message properties
        message.sender = self.sender
        message.sender_name = self.sender_name
        message.session_id = self.session_id
        message.flow_id = self.graph.flow_id if hasattr(self, "graph") else None
        message.properties.source = self._build_source(source_id, display_name, source)

        if customer_id:
            message.customer_id = customer_id
        if source_channel_id:
            message.source_channel_id = source_channel_id
        logger.debug(
            "[DEBUG LOG] | customer_id=%s | x-cus=none | stage=tchat_output_message_ready | message_session_id=%s",
            getattr(message, "customer_id", None),
            getattr(message, "session_id", None),
        )

        # Store message if needed
        if self.session_id and self.should_store_message:
            stored_message = await self.send_message(message)
            self.message.value = stored_message
            message = stored_message

        self.status = message
        out_text = getattr(message, "text", None)
        try:
            if trace is not None:
                trace.update(output=out_text)
        except Exception:
            pass

        return message

    def _serialize_data(self, data: Data) -> str:
        """Serialize Data object to JSON string."""
        # Convert data.data to JSON-serializable format
        serializable_data = jsonable_encoder(data.data)
        # Serialize with orjson, enabling pretty printing with indentation
        json_bytes = orjson.dumps(serializable_data, option=orjson.OPT_INDENT_2)
        # Convert bytes to string and wrap in Markdown code blocks
        return "```json\n" + json_bytes.decode("utf-8") + "\n```"

    def _validate_input(self) -> None:
        """Validate the input data and raise ValueError if invalid."""
        if self.input_value is None:
            msg = "Input data cannot be None"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        if isinstance(self.input_value, list) and not all(
            isinstance(item, Message | Data | DataFrame | str)
            for item in self.input_value
        ):
            invalid_types = [
                type(item).__name__
                for item in self.input_value
                if not isinstance(item, Message | Data | DataFrame | str)
            ]
            msg = f"Expected Data or DataFrame or Message or str, got {invalid_types}"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        if not isinstance(
            self.input_value,
            Message | Data | DataFrame | str | list | Generator | type(None),
        ):
            type_name = type(self.input_value).__name__
            msg = f"Expected Data or DataFrame or Message or str, Generator or None, got {type_name}"
            raise TypeError(msg)

    def convert_to_string(self) -> str | Generator[Any, None, None]:
        """Convert input data to string with proper error handling."""
        self._validate_input()
        if isinstance(self.input_value, list):
            clean_data: bool = getattr(self, "clean_data", False)
            return "\n".join(
                [
                    safe_convert(item, clean_data=clean_data)
                    for item in self.input_value
                ]
            )
        if isinstance(self.input_value, Generator):
            return self.input_value
        return safe_convert(self.input_value)

def _filter_langchain_callbacks_for_product_tree(callbacks: list | None) -> list:
    """Убираем дублирующий Langfuse/LangChain tracing, чтобы не плодить Runnable* в дереве."""
    if not callbacks:
        return []
    out = []
    for cb in callbacks:
        mod = getattr(type(cb), "__module__", "") or ""
        name = type(cb).__name__
        if "langfuse.langchain" in mod or "langfuse.callback" in mod:
            continue
        if name == "LangfuseCallbackHandler":
            continue
        out.append(cb)
    return out

            ),

        ),

                "(вместо стандартного 'Invalid or incomplete response'). "
                "Используется для направленной переформулировки следующей попытки вызова инструмента."
            ),
            value="",
        ),
    ]
    outputs = [Output(name="response", display_name="Ответ", method="get_response")]

    def get_langchain_callbacks(self):
        """Вернуть список LangChain callbacks, дополнив их телеметрией Langfuse для итераций/тулов."""
        try:
            base_callbacks = super().get_langchain_callbacks()
        except Exception:
            base_callbacks = []
        base_callbacks = _filter_langchain_callbacks_for_product_tree(base_callbacks)
        try:
            callbacks = [
            ToolCallLoggingCallback(),
            LangfuseAgentTelemetryCallback(component=self),
            *base_callbacks,
        ]
            try:
                cb_names = [getattr(cb, "__class__", type(cb)).__name__ for cb in callbacks]
                logger.debug(f"[Telemetry] get_langchain_callbacks total={len(callbacks)} -> {cb_names}")
            except Exception:
                pass
            return callbacks
        except Exception:
            return base_callbacks

    def _extract_input_text(self) -> str:
        """Достать текст запроса из разных возможных форматов input_value."""
        raw_input = getattr(self, "input_value", None) or self._attributes.get("input_value")
        if raw_input is None:
            raise ValueError("Введите текст задачи, которую должен выполнить агент.")

        text = normalize_message_like_text(raw_input).strip()
        if text:
            return text
        raise ValueError("Введите текст задачи, которую должен выполнить агент.")

    def _is_language_check_enabled(self) -> bool:
        return bool(getattr(self, "check_language_output", False))

    async def _execute_agent(self, language_model, input_text: str) -> Message:
        trace_name = "Agent Execution"
        tool_names = [getattr(tool, "name", str(tool)) for tool in self.tools]
        with trace_component(
            trace_name,
            input_data={
                "user_message": input_text,
                "system_prompt": self.system_prompt,
                "tools_count": len(self.tools),
                "tools": tool_names,
                "tool_names": tool_names,
            },
            obj=self,
            trace_kind="agent_execution",
            model=self.model_name,
            max_iterations=getattr(self, "max_iterations", None),
            has_memory=bool(self.chat_history),
        ) as trace:
            self._trace_memory(trace)

            self.set(
                llm=language_model,
                tools=self.tools,
                chat_history=self.chat_history,
                input_value=self.input_value,
                system_prompt=self.system_prompt,
            )

            agent = self.create_agent_runnable()
            agent_span = trace.span("Agent Reasoning", input_data=preview_text(input_text, max_len=2000))
            had_error = False
            error_meta: dict = {}

            try:
                result = await self.run_agent(agent)
            except Exception as exc:
                had_error = True
                error_meta = normalize_exception(exc, stage=ERROR_STAGE_AGENT)
                try:
                    agent_span.end(
                        level="ERROR",
                        status_message=error_meta.get("error_summary", str(exc)),
                        metadata=error_meta,
                    )
                except Exception:
                    pass
                trace.update(
                    output=str(exc),
                    status="error",
                    trace_kind="agent_execution",
                    final_answer_len=0,
                    tools_count=len(self.tools),
                    tool_names=tool_names,
                    **{k: v for k, v in error_meta.items() if v is not None},
                )
                propagate_error_to_flow_trace(exc, stage=ERROR_STAGE_AGENT, graph=self.graph)
                raise

            raw_text = str(getattr(result, "text", "") or "").strip()
            if getattr(self, "localize_max_iterations_message", True) and raw_text in (
                "Agent stopped due to max iterations.",
                "Agent stopped due to iteration limit or time limit.",
            ):
                logger.warning(
                    "Агент остановлен по лимиту шагов: max_iterations=%s, original_text=%r",
                    getattr(self, "max_iterations", None),
                    raw_text,
                )
                result.text = "Ошибка выполнения. Попробуйте еще раз ввести вопрос"
                had_error = True
                error_meta = normalize_exception(
                    RuntimeError(
                        "Agent stopped due to max iterations or iteration/time limit"
                    ),
                    stage=ERROR_STAGE_AGENT,
                )
                try:
                    agent_span.end(
                        level="ERROR",
                        status_message=error_meta.get("error_summary"),
                        metadata=error_meta,
                    )
                except Exception:
                    pass
            else:
                try:
                    agent_span.end(output=result.text)
                except Exception:
                    pass

            trace.update(
                output=result.text,
                status="error" if had_error else "success",
                trace_kind="agent_execution",
                final_answer_len=len(str(result.text or "")),
                tools_count=len(self.tools),
                tool_names=tool_names,
                **{k: v for k, v in error_meta.items() if had_error and v is not None},
            )
            if had_error:
                propagate_error_to_flow_trace(
                    RuntimeError(str(error_meta.get("error_summary") or "Agent execution error")),
                    stage=ERROR_STAGE_AGENT,
                    graph=self.graph,
                )
            return result

    def _trace_memory(self, trace):
        try:
            history_payload = []
            if self.chat_history:
                history_payload = [
                    {
                        "sender": getattr(m, "sender", None),
                        "sender_name": getattr(m, "sender_name", None),
                        "text": getattr(m, "text", ""),
                    }
                    for m in self.chat_history
                ]
            mem_span = trace.span(
                "Memory Retrieval",
                input_data={"has_history": bool(self.chat_history), "messages": history_payload},
            )
            mem_span.end(metadata={"messages_count": len(self.chat_history or [])})
        except Exception:
            pass

    def _get_repair_llm(self):
        def _build():
            model, _ = self._build_llm(tool_choice="none")
            return model

        return lang.get_cached_llm(self, "_repair_llm", _build)

    async def _ensure_russian_response(self, result: Message, language_model, input_text: str) -> Message:
        async def on_retry():
            nonlocal result
            result = await self._execute_agent(language_model, input_text)
            return result.text

        final_text, _ = await lang.ensure_russian_response(
            text=result.text,
            llm_for_translation=self._get_repair_llm,
            extract_text_fn=lang.extract_text_from_llm_response,
            max_retries=lang.get_language_check_retries(self),
            on_retry=on_retry,
        )
        result.text = final_text
        return result

    async def get_response(self) -> Message:
        try:
            language_model, input_text = await self._prepare_agent()
            result = await self._execute_agent(language_model, input_text)

            if self._is_language_check_enabled():
                result = await self._ensure_russian_response(result, language_model, input_text)

            return result

        except (ValueError, TypeError, KeyError, ExceptionWithMessageError) as e:
            logger.error(f"{type(e).__name__}: {e!s}")
            raise
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Неожиданная ошибка: {e!s}")
            raise

    async def _prepare_agent(self) -> tuple:
        language_model, display_name = self.get_llm()
        if language_model is None:
            raise ValueError("Выберите модель, чтобы запустить агента.")

        self.model_name = get_model_name(language_model, display_name=display_name)
        raw_input = getattr(self, "input_value", None) or self._attributes.get("input_value")
        input_text = self._extract_input_text()
        self.chat_history = await get_normalized_history(self, dedupe_text=input_text, current_input=raw_input)

        await self._add_current_date_tool_if_needed()
        self._validate_tools()
        self._configure_error_handling()
        self._ensure_input_is_message(input_text)

        return language_model, input_text

    async def _add_current_date_tool_if_needed(self):
        if not self.add_current_date_tool:
            return

        if not isinstance(self.tools, list):
            self.tools = []

        has_date_tool = any(
            isinstance(tool, StructuredTool) and getattr(tool, "name", None) == "get_current_date"
            for tool in self.tools
        )
        if has_date_tool:
            return

        current_date_component = CurrentDateComponent(**self.get_base_args()).set(timezone="Europe/Moscow")
        current_date_tool = (await current_date_component.to_toolkit()).pop(0)

        if not isinstance(current_date_tool, StructuredTool):
            raise TypeError("CurrentDateComponent должен быть преобразован в StructuredTool")

        async def _get_date_async():
            if getattr(current_date_tool, "coroutine", None):
                return await current_date_tool.coroutine(timezone="Europe/Moscow")
            return current_date_tool.func(timezone="Europe/Moscow")

        def _get_date_sync():
            return current_date_tool.func(timezone="Europe/Moscow")

        wrapped_tool = StructuredTool.from_function(
            func=_get_date_sync,
            coroutine=_get_date_async,
            name="get_current_date",
            description="Возвращает текущую дату и время в часовом поясе UTC+3.",
        )
        self.tools.append(wrapped_tool)

    def _validate_tools(self):
        if not self.tools:
            raise ValueError("Добавьте хотя бы один инструмент MCP перед запуском агента.")

    def _configure_error_handling(self):
        error_prompt = str(getattr(self, "error_repair_prompt", "") or "").strip()
        if error_prompt:
            self.handle_parsing_errors = error_prompt

    def _ensure_input_is_message(self, input_text: str):
        if not isinstance(self.input_value, Message):
            self.input_value = Message(
                text=input_text,
                sender=MESSAGE_SENDER_USER,
                sender_name=MESSAGE_SENDER_NAME_USER,
            )

    def _build_llm(self, tool_choice: str = "auto"):
        if not isinstance(self.agent_llm, str):
            return self.agent_llm, None
        try:
            provider_info = MODEL_PROVIDERS.get(self.agent_llm)
            if not provider_info:
                logger.warning(
                    f"Неизвестный провайдер модели '{self.agent_llm}'. Возврат к '{CUSTOM_PROVIDER_NAME}'."
                )
                self.agent_llm = CUSTOM_PROVIDER_NAME
                lang.invalidate_cached_llm(self, "_repair_llm")
                provider_info = MODEL_PROVIDERS[self.agent_llm]

            component_class = provider_info.get("component_class")
            display_name = component_class.display_name
            inputs = provider_info.get("inputs")
            prefix = provider_info.get("prefix", "")

            return self._build_llm_model(component_class, inputs, prefix, tool_choice=tool_choice), display_name
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Ошибка при создании языковой модели {self.agent_llm}: {e!s}")
            msg = f"Не удалось инициализировать языковую модель: {e!s}"
            raise ValueError(msg) from e

    def get_llm(self):
        """Построить и вернуть пару (модель, display_name) для агента.

        Если выбранный провайдер неизвестен, происходит фоллбэк на `Alfa on-premise`.
        """
        return self._build_llm(tool_choice="auto")

    def _build_llm_model(self, component_class, inputs, prefix="", tool_choice="auto"):
        """Вспомогательный метод: создать LLM из `component_class` и входных полей."""
        model_kwargs = {input_.name: getattr(self, f"{prefix}{input_.name}") for input_ in inputs}
        model_kwargs["tool_choice"] = tool_choice
        if getattr(self, "parallel_tool_calls", False):
            model_kwargs["parallel_tool_calls"] = True
        return component_class().set(**model_kwargs).build_model()

    def set_component_params(self, component_class):
        """Сформировать компонент провайдера с текущими параметрами для UI-обновлений."""
        provider_info = MODEL_PROVIDERS.get(self.agent_llm)
        if provider_info:
            inputs = provider_info.get("inputs")
            prefix = provider_info.get("prefix")
            model_kwargs = {input_.name: getattr(self, f"{prefix}{input_.name}") for input_ in inputs}

            return component_class().set(**model_kwargs)
        return component_class()

    def update_input_types(self, build_config: dotdict) -> dotdict:
        """Обновить типы входных данных для всех полей в build_config.
        Гарантирует, что `input_types` не равен None для корректного рендера UI.
        """
        for key, value in build_config.items():
            if isinstance(value, dict):
                if value.get("input_types") is None:
                    build_config[key]["input_types"] = []
            elif hasattr(value, "input_types") and value.input_types is None:
                value.input_types = []
        return build_config

    async def update_build_config(
        self, build_config: dotdict, field_value: str, field_name: str | None = None
    ) -> dotdict:
        """Динамически обновить build_config при изменении UI-полей агента.

        Реактивно подмешивает поля провайдера, обновляет список моделей, нормализует
        `input_types`, а также делегирует обновления низкоуровневому компоненту
        провайдера, если он это поддерживает.
        """
        # Перебрать всех провайдеров в MODEL_PROVIDERS
        # Существующая логика обновления build_config
        if field_name in (None, "agent_llm", "model_name", "system_id"):
            await update_models(build_config, field_value if field_name == "system_id" else self.system_id)
        if field_name in ("agent_llm",):
            build_config["agent_llm"]["value"] = field_value
            self.agent_llm = field_value
            lang.invalidate_cached_llm(self, "_repair_llm")

            provider_info = MODEL_PROVIDERS.get(field_value, {})
            provider_fields = provider_info.get("fields", {})
            build_config.update(provider_fields)
            build_config["agent_llm"]["input_types"] = []
            # Обновить типы входных данных для всех полей
            build_config = self.update_input_types(build_config)

            component_class = provider_info.get("component_class") if provider_info else None
            if component_class and hasattr(component_class, "update_build_config"):
                component_instance = self.set_component_params(component_class)
                model_config = build_config.get("model_name")
                model_value = model_config.get("value") if isinstance(model_config, dict) else None
                build_config = await update_component_build_config(
                    component_instance,
                    build_config,
                    model_value,
                    "model_name",
                )

            # Проверить обязательные ключи
            default_keys = [
                "code",
                "_type",
                "agent_llm",
                "tools",
                "input_value",
                "add_current_date_tool",
                "system_prompt",
                "agent_description",
                "max_iterations",
                "handle_parsing_errors",
                "verbose",
            ]
            missing_keys = [key for key in default_keys if key not in build_config]
            if missing_keys:
                msg = f"Отсутствуют обязательные ключи в build_config: {missing_keys}"
                raise ValueError(msg)
        if (
            isinstance(self.agent_llm, str)
            and self.agent_llm in MODEL_PROVIDERS
            and field_name in MODEL_DYNAMIC_UPDATE_FIELDS
        ):
            provider_info = MODEL_PROVIDERS.get(self.agent_llm)
            if provider_info:
                lang.invalidate_cached_llm(self, "_repair_llm")
                component_class = provider_info.get("component_class")
                component_class = self.set_component_params(component_class) if component_class else None
                prefix = provider_info.get("prefix")
                if component_class and hasattr(component_class, "update_build_config"):
                    # удалить префикс из field_name
                    normalized_field_name = field_name
                    if isinstance(normalized_field_name, str) and isinstance(prefix, str):
                        normalized_field_name = normalized_field_name.replace(prefix, "")
                    build_config = await update_component_build_config(
                        component_class,
                        build_config,
                        field_value,
                        normalized_field_name,
                    )

        if isinstance(field_name, str) and isinstance(self.agent_llm, str):
            provider_info = MODEL_PROVIDERS.get(self.agent_llm, {})
            provider_inputs = provider_info.get("inputs") or []
            provider_input_names = {input_.name for input_ in provider_inputs if hasattr(input_, "name")}
            prefix = provider_info.get("prefix", "")
            normalized_field_name = field_name.replace(prefix, "") if isinstance(prefix, str) and prefix else field_name
            if normalized_field_name in provider_input_names:
                lang.invalidate_cached_llm(self, "_repair_llm")

        if "tools" in build_config and isinstance(build_config["tools"], dict):
            build_config["tools"]["display_name"] = "Инструменты"
            build_config["tools"]["info"] = (
                "Инструменты, доступные агенту. Передаются из компонента «MCP инструменты»."
            )

        if "input_value" in build_config and isinstance(build_config["input_value"], dict):
            build_config["input_value"]["display_name"] = "Входные данные"
            build_config["input_value"]["placeholder"] = "Введите задачу для агента..."
            build_config["input_value"]["info"] = (
                "Текст задачи пользователя, которую агент должен выполнить."
            )

        return dotdict({k: v.to_dict() if hasattr(v, "to_dict") else v for k, v in build_config.items()})

"""Узел выбора файла из библиотеки AlfaGen Flow и передачи содержимого в поток выполнения."""

from __future__ import annotations

from copy import deepcopy
from io import BytesIO
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import chardet
from docx import Document
from langflow.base.data.base_file import BaseFileComponent
from langflow.base.data.storage_utils import read_file_bytes
from langflow.base.data.utils import (
    TEXT_FILE_TYPES,
    parallel_load_data,
    postprocess_decoded_text_by_path,
)
from langflow.inputs import BoolInput
from langflow.io import FileInput, Output
from langflow.schema.data import Data
from langflow.schema.message import Message
from langflow.utils.async_helpers import run_until_complete
from pypdf import PdfReader


class FileComponent(BaseFileComponent):
    """Чтение по пути из библиотеки файлов; тип хранилища задаётся настройками AlfaGen Flow."""

    display_name = "Файл"
    description = (
        "Читает выбранные файлы из библиотеки AlfaGen Flow и передаёт содержимое."
    )
    icon = "file-text"
    name = "AlfaFile"
    PERSONAL_DATA_DISCLAIMER = (
        "Не загружайте файлы содержащие персональные данные, "
        "банковскую тайну или иную конфиденциальную информацию. "
    )

    _BINARY_TEXT_SKIP_SUFFIXES = (
        ".png",
        ".jpg",
        ".jpeg",
        ".gif",
        ".webp",
        ".bmp",
        ".ico",
        ".xlsx",
        ".xls",
        ".parquet",
        ".zip",
        ".tar",
        ".gz",
        ".tgz",
        ".bz2",
    )

    VALID_EXTENSIONS = [
        *TEXT_FILE_TYPES,
        "adoc",
        "asciidoc",
        "asc",
        "bmp",
        "dotx",
        "dotm",
        "docm",
        "jpeg",
        "png",
        "potx",
        "ppsx",
        "pptm",
        "potm",
        "ppsm",
        "pptx",
        "tiff",
        "xls",
        "xlsx",
        "xhtml",
        "webp",
    ]

    _base_inputs = deepcopy(BaseFileComponent._base_inputs)
    for _inp in _base_inputs:
        if isinstance(_inp, FileInput) and _inp.name == "path":
            _inp.real_time_refresh = True
            _inp.display_name = "Файлы"
            break

    inputs = [
        *_base_inputs,
        BoolInput(
            name="tool_mode_flag",
            display_name="Tool Mode",
            value=False,
            show=False,  # скрыть из UI
            advanced=True,
            tool_mode=True,  # это включает свичер Tool mode на фронте
            real_time_refresh=True,
        ),
    ]

    def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
        for inp in self.inputs:
            if getattr(inp, "name", None) == "path" and isinstance(inp, FileInput):
                inp.display_name = "Файлы"
                types_preview = ", ".join(getattr(inp, "file_types", [])[:18])
                if len(getattr(inp, "file_types", [])) > 18:
                    types_preview += ", …"
                inp.info = (
                    "Выберите файл в окне «Мои файлы» или перетащите сюда. "
                    f"Поддерживаются расширения: {types_preview}; также архивы zip, tar, tgz, bz2, gz. "
                    f"{self.PERSONAL_DATA_DISCLAIMER}"
                )
                break

    outputs = [
        Output(
            display_name="Содержимое файла",
            name="message",
            method="read_file",
            types=["Message"],
        ),
    ]

    @staticmethod
    def _object_name_from_storage_path(file_path: str) -> str:
        normalized = file_path.replace("\\", "/").strip().strip("/")
        return normalized.rsplit("/", 1)[-1] if "/" in normalized else normalized

    @staticmethod
    def _is_blocked_mcp_path(file_path: str) -> bool:
        tail = FileComponent._object_name_from_storage_path(file_path)
        return tail.startswith("_mcp_servers") or "_mcp_servers" in file_path.replace("\\", "/")

    @staticmethod
    def _decode_bytes(raw: bytes) -> str:
        det = chardet.detect(raw)
        enc = det.get("encoding") or "utf-8"
        if enc in {"Windows-1252", "Windows-1254", "MacRoman"}:
            enc = "utf-8"
        return raw.decode(enc, errors="replace")

    @classmethod
    def _parse_file_to_data(cls, file_path: str, *, silent_errors: bool) -> Data | None:
        fp = str(file_path).replace("\\", "/")
        low = fp.lower()
        try:
            if cls._is_blocked_mcp_path(fp):
                msg = "Служебный файл недоступен"
                if not silent_errors:
                    raise ValueError(msg)
                return None

            if any(low.endswith(s) for s in cls._BINARY_TEXT_SKIP_SUFFIXES):
                name = Path(fp).name
                text = (
                    f"Файл «{name}» — двоичный или табличный без текстового превью в этом узле. "
                    "Подключите выход к компоненту, который ожидает файл/байты, либо используйте CSV/JSON/текст."
                )
                return Data(data={"file_path": fp, "text": text})

            if fp.endswith(".pdf"):
                raw = run_until_complete(read_file_bytes(fp))
                with BytesIO(raw) as bio, PdfReader(bio) as reader:
                    text = "\n\n".join((page.extract_text() or "") for page in reader.pages)
            elif fp.endswith(".docx"):
                raw = run_until_complete(read_file_bytes(fp))
                doc = Document(BytesIO(raw))
                text = "\n\n".join(p.text for p in doc.paragraphs)
            else:
                raw = run_until_complete(read_file_bytes(fp))
                text = cls._decode_bytes(raw)

            text = postprocess_decoded_text_by_path(fp, text)

        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
            if not silent_errors:
                msg = f"Ошибка чтения файла {fp}: {e}"
                raise ValueError(msg) from e
            return None

        return Data(data={"file_path": fp, "text": text})

    def process_files(self, file_list: list[BaseFileComponent.BaseFile]) -> list[BaseFileComponent.BaseFile]:
        if not file_list:
            msg = "Нет файлов для обработки."
            raise ValueError(msg)

        def load_one(file_path: str, *, silent_errors: bool = False) -> Data | None:

    display_name = "Message History"

    icon = "message-square-more"
    name = "Memory"
    default_keys = ["mode", "memory", "session_id"]
    mode_config = {
        "Store": ["message", "memory", "sender", "sender_name", "session_id"],
        "Retrieve": ["n_messages", "order", "template", "memory", "session_id"],
    }

    inputs = [
        TabInput(
            name="mode",
            display_name="Mode",
            options=["Retrieve", "Store"],
            value="Retrieve",
            info="Operation mode: Store messages or Retrieve messages.",
            real_time_refresh=True,

            name="memory",

            input_types=["Memory"],
            info="Retrieve messages from an external memory. If empty, it will use the Langflow tables.",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        DropdownInput(
            name="sender_type",
            display_name="Sender Type",
            options=[MESSAGE_SENDER_AI, MESSAGE_SENDER_USER, "Machine and User"],
            value="Machine and User",

        MessageTextInput(

            "If empty, the current sender parameter will be used.",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="sender_name",
            display_name="Sender Name",
            info="Filter by sender name.",
            advanced=True,
            show=False,
        ),
        IntInput(
            name="n_messages",
            display_name="Number of Messages",
            value=100,
            info="Number of messages to retrieve.",
            advanced=True,
            show=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="session_id",
            display_name="Session ID",
            info="The session ID of the chat. If empty, the current session ID parameter will be used.",
            value="",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        DropdownInput(
            name="order",
            display_name="Order",
            options=["Ascending", "Descending"],
            value="Ascending",
            info="Order of the messages.",
            advanced=True,
            tool_mode=True,
            required=True,
        ),
        MultilineInput(
            name="template",
            display_name="Template",
            info="The template to use for formatting the data. "
            "It can contain the keys {text}, {sender} or any other key in the message data.",
            value="{sender_name}: {text}",
            advanced=True,
            show=False,
        ),
    ]

    outputs = [
        Output(display_name="Message", name="messages_text", method="retrieve_messages_as_text", dynamic=True),
        Output(display_name="Dataframe", name="dataframe", method="retrieve_messages_dataframe", dynamic=True),
    ]

    def update_outputs(self, frontend_node: dict, field_name: str, field_value: Any) -> dict:
        """Dynamically show only the relevant output based on the selected output type."""
        if field_name == "mode":
            # Start with empty outputs
            frontend_node["outputs"] = []
            if field_value == "Store":
                frontend_node["outputs"] = [
                    Output(
                        display_name="Stored Messages",
                        name="stored_messages",
                        method="store_message",
                        hidden=True,
                        dynamic=True,
                    )
                ]
            if field_value == "Retrieve":
                frontend_node["outputs"] = [
                    Output(
                        display_name="Messages", name="messages_text", method="retrieve_messages_as_text", dynamic=True
                    ),
                    Output(
                        display_name="Dataframe", name="dataframe", method="retrieve_messages_dataframe", dynamic=True
                    ),
                ]
        return frontend_node

    async def store_message(self) -> Message:
        message = Message(text=self.message) if isinstance(self.message, str) else self.message

        message.session_id = self.session_id or message.session_id
        message.sender = self.sender or message.sender or MESSAGE_SENDER_AI
        message.sender_name = self.sender_name or message.sender_name or MESSAGE_SENDER_NAME_AI

        stored_messages: list[Message] = []

        if self.memory:
            self.memory.session_id = message.session_id
            lc_message = message.to_lc_message()
            await self.memory.aadd_messages([lc_message])

            stored_messages = await self.memory.aget_messages() or []

            stored_messages = [Message.from_lc_message(m) for m in stored_messages] if stored_messages else []

            if message.sender:
                stored_messages = [m for m in stored_messages if m.sender == message.sender]
        else:
            await astore_message(message, flow_id=self.graph.flow_id)
            stored_messages = (
                await aget_messages(
                    session_id=message.session_id, sender_name=message.sender_name, sender=message.sender
                )
                or []
            )

        if not stored_messages:
            msg = "No messages were stored. Please ensure that the session ID and sender are properly set."
            raise ValueError(msg)

        stored_message = stored_messages[0]
        self.status = stored_message
        return stored_message

    async def retrieve_messages(self) -> Data:
        sender_type = self.sender_type
        sender_name = self.sender_name
        session_id = self.session_id
        n_messages = self.n_messages
        order = "DESC" if self.order == "Descending" else "ASC"

        if sender_type == "Machine and User":
            sender_type = None

        if self.memory and not hasattr(self.memory, "aget_messages"):
            memory_name = type(self.memory).__name__
            err_msg = f"External Memory object ({memory_name}) must have 'aget_messages' method."
            raise AttributeError(err_msg)
        # Check if n_messages is None or 0
        if n_messages == 0:
            stored = []
        elif self.memory:
            # override session_id
            self.memory.session_id = session_id

            stored = await self.memory.aget_messages()
            # langchain memories are supposed to return messages in ascending order

            if n_messages:
                stored = stored[-n_messages:]  # Get last N messages first

            if order == "DESC":
                stored = stored[::-1]  # Then reverse if needed

            stored = [Message.from_lc_message(m) for m in stored]
            if sender_type:
                expected_type = MESSAGE_SENDER_AI if sender_type == MESSAGE_SENDER_AI else MESSAGE_SENDER_USER
                stored = [m for m in stored if m.type == expected_type]
        else:
            # For internal memory, we always fetch the last N messages by ordering by DESC
            stored = await aget_messages(
                sender=sender_type,
                sender_name=sender_name,
                session_id=session_id,
                limit=10000,
                order=order,
            )
            if n_messages:
                stored = stored[-n_messages:]  # Get last N messages

        # self.status = stored
        return cast("Data", stored)

    async def retrieve_messages_as_text(self) -> Message:
        stored_text = data_to_text(self.template, await self.retrieve_messages())
        # self.status = stored_text
        return Message(text=stored_text)

    async def retrieve_messages_dataframe(self) -> DataFrame:
        """Convert the retrieved messages into a DataFrame.

        Returns:
            DataFrame: A DataFrame containing the message data.
        """
        messages = await self.retrieve_messages()
        return DataFrame(messages)

    def update_build_config(
        self,
        build_config: dotdict,
        field_value: Any,  # noqa: ARG002
        field_name: str | None = None,  # noqa: ARG002
    ) -> dotdict:
        return set_current_fields(
            build_config=build_config,
            action_fields=self.mode_config,
            selected_action=build_config["mode"]["value"],
            default_fields=self.default_keys,
            func=set_field_display,
        )
